lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct white vertical lines are visible; spacing is widest in the central torso region and progressively narrower towards the anterior and posterior boundaries.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed in the fourth and fifth anterior line segments where they merge as they approach the dorsal ridge; small Y-shaped split visible on the upper section of the sixth line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 1 is highly truncated, visible only as a shoulder segment; lines 2, 8, and 11 terminate before reaching the ventral hair fringe or dorsal mane.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of four distinct white spots is located on the mid-posterior haunch; two additional isolated spots are visible further posterior near the tail base.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the lower haunch exhibit a horizontal linear alignment; three spots on the mid-haunch form a diagonal geometric line pointing towards the hock.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature; horns project dorsocaudally from the skull with a lateral flare, then recurve medially at the terminals.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Approximately 1.3:1 (ratio of pixel distance between horn tips to the cumulative pixel width of the two horn bases).
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.15 (estimated length of high-contrast ivory apical tipping relative to the total visible horn length).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular reddish-brown patch on the dorsal-lateral neck region indicating a possible lesion or area of physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white-grey dorsal crest; white chevron-like markings on the bridge of the muzzle; distinct tan-orange distal limb coloration below the carpus and hock.
